turns.text:
I’ll run the inverse design with the stated targets and search space, then report the lowest CO₂ candidates and their uncertainty.
The lowest CO₂ candidate misses the strength target at its median prediction. The leading candidate is closer, but its predicted flow is below the target and the flow model is weak. I’ll check measured literature analogues before recommending a trial mix.
**Lowest CO₂ candidate meeting the tool’s individual probability thresholds:** OPC 67% / Class F fly ash 33%, **w/b 0.309**, with no admixture. Estimated CO₂ is **845 kg/m³**. Predicted mini-slump diameter is **189 [99, 294] mm** and 7-day compressive strength is **31.9 [23.0, 59.7] MPa** (q50 [q10, q90]). The estimated probability of meeting both targets is **27%**.

**This is a trial mix, not a confirmed design that meets both requirements.** Its median flow misses 200 mm, and the mini-slump model is weak; treat that prediction as order-of-magnitude guidance. The lower-CO₂ candidate, OPC 50% / fly ash 50% at w/b 0.386, has a median 7-day strength of **24.1 MPa**, so I would not select it for the strength target.

As primary flow evidence, a published paste with OPC 85% / Class F fly ash 15%, w/b 0.30 and PCE 0.50% measured **268 mm** mini-slump flow and **82 MPa** at 7 days. Its PCE addition is outside the specified search space. [Literature analogue](https://doi.org/10.3389/fmats.2021.712551)

I used paste, moist curing, a 50 mm cube strength comparison, and no 3DCP condition; the age was your specified 7 days. Measure flow and 7-day strength before adopting the trial mix.
